text: The specific beings in the hells arise from the actions of the damned. Endowed with distinct colors, forms, sizes, and strengths, they are designated by names such as the hell-keepers. Thus, they manifest as follows: they are seen performing actions such as waving their hands in two directions in order to instill fear. For example, when the mountain-like beings approach or depart, the thorns in the iron-forest hell turn downward and then upward.
